provider: Microsoft 365 Business Basic — nonprofit grant (300 free seats x 1 TB OneDrive)

free_tier.stated: Microsoft 365 Business Basic (Nonprofit Staff Pricing) is a 'Grant — Free up to 300 users', and every seat carries '1 TB of cloud storage per user' (OneDrive). 300 x 1 TB = 300 TB of pooled tenant storage at zero cost. SharePoint on top: total org storage '1 TB + 10GB per license purchased', max 25 TB per site collection.

egress.terms: No egress meter on OneDrive/SharePoint downloads — Microsoft does not bill data transfer out for M365 storage. Put Cloudflare in front and it is fully covered.

tooling: rclone backend 'onedrive' (Tier 1, chunked upload, server-side move); Microsoft Graph API (/me/drive, /sites/{id}/drive); SharePoint REST. The Graph endpoints are the documented programmatic path.
chaining: The multiplier here is seats, not orgs: 300 granted seats per nonprofit tenant, 1 TB each, plus 10 GB of SharePoint pool per licence with a 25 TB ceiling per site collection — so a single tenant can present 300 TB of OneDrive *and* multi-TB SharePoint document libraries. 300 seats at 1 TB is the largest free number found anywhere in this niche. Multiple 501(c)(3) entities = separate tenants.
limits_note: per-object-cap 250 GB per file in OneDrive (Microsoft's documented ceiling), 100 GB mailbox, SharePoint list/library max 30 million items. request-rate: Graph throttling is per-app-per-tenant and is the practical ceiling for bulk sync, not bytes. retention: perpetual while the subscription renews; Microsoft requires '85% active usage of all granted assigned licenses' or the org risks losing future grants.
reliability_note: The grant survived the July 2025 cull that killed *donated* Business Premium and O365 E1 — Business Basic is still listed as 'Grant, Free up to 300 users'. Unused seats are reclaimed under the 85% rule; inactive tenants risk losing grants at renewal.
